english: Too hard, if you ask me.
french: Trop dur, même, si tu veux mon avis.
russian: Слишком много, если хочешь знать моё мнение.
bulgarian: Too hard, if you ask me.

english: Glad you're here to lend her a hand, [Ari].
french: Je suis contente que tu sois là pour lui donner un coup de main, [Ari].
russian: Хорошо, что ты рядом и можешь ей помочь, [Ari].
bulgarian: Glad you're here to lend her a hand, [Ari].

english: Adeline's been working so hard lately.
french: Adeline travaille très dur, en ce moment.
russian: Аделина в последнее время так много работает.
bulgarian: Adeline's been working so hard lately.

english: I asked some folk to come by for a taste testing. Here, try it!
french: J'ai demandé à des volontaires de venir tester ma nouvelle recette. Tiens, goûte !
russian: Я позвала пару знакомых на дегустацию. Вот, попробуй!
bulgarian: I asked some folk to come by for a taste testing. Here, try it!

english: Hi there! Don't be a stranger now!
french: Bonjour ! Tu passes nous voir quand tu veux !
russian: Привет! Не проходи мимо!
bulgarian: Hi there! Don't be a stranger now!

english: Juniper really outdid herself, reopening the old bathhouse. I come here every chance I get!
french: Juniper s'est vraiment surpassée en rouvrant les anciens bains. Je viens dès que j'en ai l'occasion !
russian: Джунипер просто молодец, что восстановила старую купальню Я прихожу при каждой возможности!
bulgarian: Juniper really outdid herself, reopening the old bathhouse. I come here every chance I get!

english: It's another beautiful morning in Mistria.
french: C'est encore une belle matinée à Mistria !
russian: Ещё одно прекрасное утро в Мистрии.
bulgarian: It's another beautiful morning in Mistria.

english: The kids should be home for dinner soon... I'll tidy up a little bit.
french: Les enfants ne devraient plus tarder à rentrer pour dîner. Je vais ranger un peu.
russian: Дети скоро вернутся к ужину... надо немного прибраться
bulgarian: The kids should be home for dinner soon... I'll tidy up a little bit.

english: Ooh, a hot bath in this brisk weather was just the ticket! I feel brand new!
french: Oh, un bon bain chaud par ce temps frais, c'est exactement ce qu'il me fallait ! Je me sens regonflée !
russian: Ох, горячая ванна в такую прохладу — самое то! Будто заново родилась!
bulgarian: Ooh, a hot bath in this brisk weather was just the ticket! I feel brand new!

english: I wish you could have seen it, [Ari]!
french: Si seulement tu avais pu la voir, [Ari].
russian: Жаль, тебе не удалось её увидеть, [Ari]!
bulgarian: I wish you could have seen it, [Ari]!

english: In my head, Mistria is still the bustling town it used to be before the earthquake.
french: Je vois toujours Mistria comme la ville animée qu'elle était avant le tremblement de terre.
russian: В голове у меня Мистрия всё ещё та: оживлённая, прежняя, до землетрясения.
bulgarian: In my head, Mistria is still the bustling town it used to be before the earthquake.

english: I'm making chocolate cake! The kids like it with extra chocolate.
french: Je fais un gâteau au chocolat ! Avec un supplément de chocolat pour les enfants.
russian: Я пеку шоколадный торт! Дети любят, когда в нём особенно много шоколада.
bulgarian: I'm making chocolate cake! The kids like it with extra chocolate.

english: I found a stick in here, but I'm not quite sure whether it's Luc's bug inspector or Maple's royal scepter.
french: Je viens de trouver un bâton, mais je ne sais pas si c'est la baguette d'entomologie de Luc ou le sceptre royal de Maple.
russian: Нашла тут палку, но не уверена, что это: тыкалка жуков Люка или королевский скипетр Мэйпл.
bulgarian: I found a stick in here, but I'm not quite sure whether it's Luc's bug inspector or Maple's royal scepter.

english: One for my baby and one for you ~
french: Marguerite, je te cueillerai ~
russian: Одна — для малыша, другая — для тебя...
bulgarian: One for my baby and one for you ~

english: Picking daisies a'one, a'two ~
french: Marguerite, jolie marguerite ~
russian: Срываю ромашки: и раз, и два...
bulgarian: Picking daisies a'one, a'two ~

english: Hemlock is such a gentleman... What a perfect day with a perfect man.
french: Hemlock est un vrai gentleman... C'est une journée idéale avec l'homme parfait.
russian: Хемлок — такой джентльмен... Идеальный день с идеальным мужчиной.
bulgarian: Hemlock is such a gentleman... What a perfect day with a perfect man.

english: He must love to lose.
french: Ce garçon doit vraiment aimer perdre.
russian: Должно быть, он обожает проигрывать.
bulgarian: He must love to lose.

english: Balor challenged me to a drinking contest.
french: Balor veut que nous nous affrontions dans un concours de boisson.
russian: Балор вызвал меня на питейный поединок.
bulgarian: Balor challenged me to a drinking contest.

english: Come in from the cold a while... I'll put on the mint and the chamomile...
french: Viens donc te mettre au chaud un petit moment... Je prépare des tisanes...
russian: Заходи с холода... Я поставлю завариваться мяту с ромашкой...
bulgarian: Come in from the cold a while... I'll put on the mint and the chamomile...

english: [Ari]! Are you eating enough? I won't be happy unless you take some leftovers home.
french: Est-ce que tu te nourris bien, [Ari] ? Je tiens à ce que tu prennes ces quelques restes.
russian: [Ari]! Ты точно ешь как надо? Я не отпущу тебя, пока ты не заберёшь с собой остатки!
bulgarian: [Ari]! Are you eating enough? I won't be happy unless you take some leftovers home.

english: Nothing like a hot bath to warm you up on a chilly fall day.
french: Rien de tel qu'un bain chaud par une journée d'automne un peu fraîche !
russian: Нет ничего лучше горячей ванны в прохладный осенний день.
bulgarian: Nothing like a hot bath to warm you up on a chilly fall day.

english: How do they get in here?
french: Comment arrivent-elles là ?
russian: Как они сюда попадают?
bulgarian: How do they get in here?

english: I know it's fall because I keep finding leaves indoors!
french: Je sais que l'automne est bien là quand je trouve des feuilles partout dans la maison.
russian: Понимаю, что уже осень, по количеству листьев, которые нахожу дома!
bulgarian: I know it's fall because I keep finding leaves indoors!

english: I wonder what fresh produce they've got over at the General Store. Maybe I'll drop by later.
french: Je me demande quels produits frais ils ont reçus au magasin général. J'irai peut-être y faire un tour tout à l'heure.
russian: Интересно, какие свежие продукты в лавке? Может, загляну потом.
bulgarian: I wonder what fresh produce they've got over at the General Store. Maybe I'll drop by later.

english: Hemlock talked me into a song... he's still got a silver tongue, that one.
french: Hemlock m'a encore convaincue de pousser la chansonnette... Il a toujours été très persuasif.
russian: Хемлок уговорил меня спеть... не растярял же свой талант к убеждению.
bulgarian: Hemlock talked me into a song... he's still got a silver tongue, that one.

english: Delighted to meet you [Ari]. You can call me Josephine, though I also go by Jo.
french: Enchantée de te rencontrer, [Ari]. Tu peux m'appeler Joséphine, ou Jo si tu préfères.
russian: Очень рада знакомству, [Ari]. Можешь звать меня Джозефина — или просто Джо.
bulgarian: Delighted to meet you [Ari]. You can call me Josephine, though I also go by Jo.

english: I run the $Sleeping Dragon Inn$ with my husband, Hemlock, and our children, Reina, Maple and Luc. Have you met them all yet?
french: Je tiens l'$auberge du Dragon qui dort$ avec mon mari, Hemlock, et nos enfants, Reina, Maple et Luc. Tu les as déjà tous croisés ?
russian:
Я владею $трактиром «Спящий дракон»$ вместе с мужем Хемлоком и нашими детьми — Рейной, Мэйпл и Люком. Ты уже

познакомились

познакомиласьпознакомилсяпознакомилось с ними?
bulgarian: I run the $Sleeping Dragon Inn$ with my husband, Hemlock, and our children, Reina, Maple and Luc. Have you met them all yet?

english: Stop by anytime dear. You're always welcome whether you need a meal or just want a chat.
french: Passe ici quand tu veux, mon chou. Nous serons toujours ravis de te voir, que ce soit pour un repas ou pour une petite discussion.
russian: Заходи в любое время, душка. Всегда тебе рада: хочешь — поесть, хочешь — просто поболтать.
bulgarian: Stop by anytime dear. You're always welcome whether you need a meal or just want a chat.

english: It'd be my pleasure to serve up either!
french: Ce sera un plaisir de t'offrir l'un ou l'autre !
russian: Для меня одно удовольствие подать и то и другое!
bulgarian: It'd be my pleasure to serve up either!

english: Well, you must be our new farmer! Adeline mentioned you'd be arriving soon.
french: Bonjour ! C'est sûrement toi qui viens habiter la ferme. Adeline a dit que tu devais arriver bientôt.
russian:
А, это ты

наши новые фермер

наша новая фермерканаш новый фермернаше новое фермер. Аделина говорила, что ты скоро

приедете

приедешьприедешьприедешь.
bulgarian: Well, you must be our new farmer! Adeline mentioned you'd be arriving soon.

english: Hemlock's pretty good at cards, but Balor seems like a bit of a shark. Of course Terithia's the biggest shark of them all, she'd clean them both out!
french: Hemlock se débrouille bien aux cartes, mais Balor est un sacré roublard. Enfin la plus douée reste tout de même Terithia. Elle les battrait tous les deux à plate couture.
russian: Хемлок неплохо играет в карты, но Балор — настоящий шулер. А Теризия — настоящий хищник и обыграет обоих!
bulgarian: Hemlock's pretty good at cards, but Balor seems like a bit of a shark. Of course Terithia's the biggest shark of them all, she'd clean them both out!

english: Personally, I love a husband who cleans!
french: Moi, j'aime avoir un mari qui participe aux tâches ménagères !
russian: Я лично обожаю, когда муж убирается!
bulgarian: Personally, I love a husband who cleans!

english: Thank goodness Hemlock loves a tidy inn.
french: Heureusement, Hemlock aime que l'auberge soit toujours propre.
russian: Слава богу, Хемлок любит порядок в трактире.
bulgarian: Thank goodness Hemlock loves a tidy inn.

english: Hemlock's so handsome, isn't he? We've been together for ages, but he's aged like a fine wine.
french: Hemlock est charmant, n'est-ce pas ? Nous sommes ensemble depuis longtemps, mais il se bonifie avec l'âge.
russian: Хемлок такой красавчик, правда? Мы давно вместе, но он — как хорошее вино: только лучше с возрастом.
bulgarian: Hemlock's so handsome, isn't he? We've been together for ages, but he's aged like a fine wine.

english: Hemlock's a sweetheart, he always has tea waiting for me at the beginning of my shift.
french: Hemlock est si attentionné... Il me prépare toujours un thé pour bien commencer ma journée de travail.
russian: Хемлок — золото: всегда заваривает мне чай к началу смены.
bulgarian: Hemlock's a sweetheart, he always has tea waiting for me at the beginning of my shift.

english: Hemlock's on the till for a bit, perfect time to tidy the yard!
french: Comme Hemlock est à la caisse, j'en profite pour nettoyer la cour !
russian: Хемлок у кассы, а у меня — отличная возможность прибраться во дворе!
bulgarian: Hemlock's on the till for a bit, perfect time to tidy the yard!

english: I wonder what the kids are up to... I hope they're not playing in the fountain again, they never remember to dry their shoes.
french: Je me demande ce que font les enfants... J'espère qu'ils ne sont pas encore en train de jouer dans la fontaine, ils reviennent toujours avec les pieds trempés.
russian: Интересно, чем заняты дети... Надеюсь, не плещутся снова в фонтане: они вечно забывают сушить обувь.
bulgarian: I wonder what the kids are up to... I hope they're not playing in the fountain again, they never remember to dry their shoes.

english: Nothing like a hot cup of tea while you're doing the day's work!
french: Rien ne vaut une bonne tasse de thé pour se motiver pendant une journée de travail !
russian: Нет ничего лучше чашки горячего чая во время работы.
bulgarian: Nothing like a hot cup of tea while you're doing the day's work!

english: Reina's the rising star, but the whole family can whip up something special in the kitchen. In fact, try this!
french: Reina est promise à un grand avenir en cuisine, mais chacun de nous a sa spécialité. D'ailleurs, goûte ça !
russian: Рейна, конечно, настоящая звезда, но так-то вся наша семья творит чудеса на кухне. Вот, попробуй!
bulgarian: Reina's the rising star, but the whole family can whip up something special in the kitchen. In fact, try this!

english: My my, the Inn is bustling tonight!
french: Oh là là, l'auberge est très animée ce soir !
russian: Ого, сегодня в трактире прямо аншлаг!
bulgarian: My my, the Inn is bustling tonight!

english: The Sleeping Dragon Inn... is awake!
french: Le Dragon qui dort... se réveille !
russian: «Спящий дракон»... проснулся!
bulgarian: The Sleeping Dragon Inn... is awake!

english: Big inn like ours takes a lot of running, but I take pride in all of it!
french: On ne s'arrête jamais quand on tient une grande auberge comme la nôtre, mais c'est une telle fierté !
russian: Большой трактир требует много забот, но я этим горжусь!
bulgarian: Big inn like ours takes a lot of running, but I take pride in all of it!

english: Oh, but I do miss the summer! We'd both better keep moving if we want to stay warm!
french: Oh, comme l'été me manque ! Ne restons pas sans bouger, on risque d'attraper froid.
russian: Ах, как же я скучаю по лету! Нам с тобой лучше двигаться, если не хотим замёрзнуть!
bulgarian: Oh, but I do miss the summer! We'd both better keep moving if we want to stay warm!

english: Kitchen's open if you're hungry, [Ari]! Just let me know what you'd like.
french: Si tu as faim, la cuisine est ouverte, [Ari] ! Dis-moi ce qui te tente.
russian: Кухня открыта, если хочешь есть, [Ari]! Скажи, что тебе по вкусу.
bulgarian: Kitchen's open if you're hungry, [Ari]! Just let me know what you'd like.

english: There's always a little more to do when you run an Inn, but that's why I like it! It keeps me busy!
french: Quand on tient une auberge, il y a toujours quelque chose à faire, mais c'est précisément ce que j'aime ! Je ne m'ennuie jamais !
russian: В трактире всегда есть что поделать, и именно это мне в нём и нравится! Постоянное движение!
bulgarian: There's always a little more to do when you run an Inn, but that's why I like it! It keeps me busy!

english: Luc and Maple have been really into broccoli lately... I better make the most of it while it lasts!
french: Luc et Maple ne mangent que des brocolis dernièrement... J'en profite tant que ça dure !
russian: Люк и Мэйпл в последнее время полюбили брокколи... Надо пользоваться моментом, пока не надоело!
bulgarian: Luc and Maple have been really into broccoli lately... I better make the most of it while it lasts!

english: It was tough getting Maple and Luc to sleep the other night. They were too excited about some adventure they had!
french: Luc et Maple ont eu du mal à s'endormir l'autre soir. Ils parlaient sans arrêt d'une de leurs aventures !
russian: Недавно было нелегко уложить Люка и Мэйпл спать. Они были слишком взволнованы каким-то приключением!
bulgarian: It was tough getting Maple and Luc to sleep the other night. They were too excited about some adventure they had!

english: They grow up so quickly!
french: Les enfants grandissent si vite !
russian: Как же они быстро растут!
bulgarian: They grow up so quickly!

english: You know, used to be a time that Luc and Maple wouldn't fall asleep unless I sang them a lullaby.
french: Tu sais, quand ils étaient plus petits, Luc et Maple ne s'endormaient pas tant que je ne leur avais pas chanté une berceuse.
russian: Знаешь, раньше Люк и Мэйпл не могли уснуть, если я им колыбельную не спою.
bulgarian: You know, used to be a time that Luc and Maple wouldn't fall asleep unless I sang them a lullaby.

english: He's not the best at communicating his feelings. He's always been like that.
french: Il ne sait pas vraiment exprimer ses sentiments. Il a toujours été comme ça.
russian: Он плохо умеет выражать свои чувства. Всегда такой был.
bulgarian: He's not the best at communicating his feelings. He's always been like that.

english: But it looks like he's getting better... Congratulations on getting through to him!
french: Mais il a l'air de s'améliorer... Bravo d'avoir réussi à l'atteindre !
russian: Но, кажется, сейчас становится лучше... Поздравляю, тебе удалось к нему пробиться!
bulgarian: But it looks like he's getting better... Congratulations on getting through to him!

english: I've known March since he was a little one, so I can read him like a book.
french: Je connais March depuis qu'il est petit. Je lis en lui comme dans un livre ouvert.
russian: Я знала Марта, ещё когда он был маленьким. Так что я вижу его насквозь.
bulgarian: I've known March since he was a little one, so I can read him like a book.

english: The plates kept piling up because he kept remaking it...
french: Il y avait de la vaisselle partout parce qu'il n'arrêtait pas de recommencer...
russian: Он его постоянно переделывал, так что у нас скопилась груда тарелок...
bulgarian: The plates kept piling up because he kept remaking it...

english: He wanted it to be perfect. Eventually, there was nothing to do but shoo him out of the kitchen!
french: Il voulait que tout soit parfait. Finalement, je n'ai pas eu d'autre choix que de le chasser de la cuisine !
russian: Хотел, чтобы получилось идеально. В конце концов нам пришлось прогнать его из кухни!
bulgarian: He wanted it to be perfect. Eventually, there was nothing to do but shoo him out of the kitchen!

english: Did March give you that =Mushroom Steak Dinner=? Don't tell him I told you, but he worked so hard on that.
french: March t'a offert son =plat de pleurotes= ? Ne lui répète pas, mais il s'est donné un mal fou pour le préparer.
russian: Март отдал тебе =ужин с грибным стейком=? Он над ним так трудился. Только не говори ему, что я рассказала.
bulgarian: Did March give you that =Mushroom Steak Dinner=? Don't tell him I told you, but he worked so hard on that.

english: Mistria's been a little more lively since you arrived, [Ari]. It makes my heart swell!
french: Je trouve que Mistria est plus vivante depuis que tu es là, [Ari]. Et ça me fait chaud au cœur !
russian:
С тех пор, как ты

приехали

приехалаприехалприехало, [Ari], Мистрия стала немного живее. И на сердце теплее!
bulgarian: Mistria's been a little more lively since you arrived, [Ari]. It makes my heart swell!

english: On the one hand, troublesome. On the other hand, I admire their initiative.
french: Je trouve ça un peu pénible, mais je ne peux qu'admirer leur esprit d'initiative.
russian: С одной стороны — хлопотно, с другой — уважаю их подход!
bulgarian: On the one hand, troublesome. On the other hand, I admire their initiative.

english: I told the kids they had to help me clean today, and it turned into a negotiation.
french: J'ai demandé aux enfants de m'aider à faire le ménage aujourd'hui, et ça a viré à la négociation.
russian: Сказала детям, что сегодня они помогают мне убираться — а в итоге начались переговоры.
bulgarian: I told the kids they had to help me clean today, and it turned into a negotiation.

english: Suppose I'll just have to get both!
french: Bon, je vais prendre les deux !
russian: Пожалуй, возьму и то и другое!
bulgarian: Suppose I'll just have to get both!

english: It takes a lot to run an Inn! Reina's picking up about half of it from Hayden, and I'm picking up the other half just now. Now, did Reina say tomato or potato?
french: La nourriture est très importante dans une auberge ! Reina se fournit pour moitié chez Hayden, et je m'occupe du reste. Au fait, elle voulait des tomates ou des patates ?
russian: Управлять трактиром — дело непростое! Рейна пошла за частью продуктов к Хейдену, а я сейчас разбираюсь с остальным. Что там она просила? Помидоры? Нет, кажется, картошку...
bulgarian: It takes a lot to run an Inn! Reina's picking up about half of it from Hayden, and I'm picking up the other half just now. Now, did Reina say tomato or potato?

english: Reina made =Quiche= out of some of the eggs she got from Hayden. Mm-mm!
french: Reina a fait une =quiche= avec les œufs qu'Hayden lui a donnés. Miam miam !
russian: Рейна сделала =киш= из яиц с фермы Хейдена. М-м-м!
bulgarian: Reina made =Quiche= out of some of the eggs she got from Hayden. Mm-mm!

english: The sound of rain on the roof! The crackle of the fire! How lovely.
french: Comme j'aime le bruit de la pluie sur le toit et le crépitement du bois dans la cheminée !
russian: Шум дождя по крыше! Треск огня в камине! Прелесть.
bulgarian: The sound of rain on the roof! The crackle of the fire! How lovely.

english: The bathhouse somehow becomes MORE inviting when it rains. What's up with that?
french: Quand il pleut, j'ai encore plus envie d'aller aux bains que d'habitude. Comment ça se fait ?
russian: Купальня в дождь становится ещё уютнее. Как это вообще работает?
bulgarian: The bathhouse somehow becomes MORE inviting when it rains. What's up with that?

english: Rainy days tend to be busy for us... Reina's gone to the General Store to stock up.
french: Nous avons plus de travail les jours de pluie... Reina est allée au magasin général pour acheter ce qu'il manque.
russian: Дождливые дни у нас самые загруженные... Рейна пошла в лавку пополнить запасы.
bulgarian: Rainy days tend to be busy for us... Reina's gone to the General Store to stock up.

english: "A large component of honeybee communication is in a complex dance language-"
french: « La communication entre les abeilles repose principalement sur un langage complexe qui peut s'apparenter à une forme de danse... »
russian: «Большая часть коммуникации пчёл — это сложный танец...»
bulgarian: "A large component of honeybee communication is in a complex dance language-"

english: [Ari]! So nice to see you. Make yourself comfortable, and let me know if I can get you anything!
french: Quel plaisir de te voir, [Ari] ! Mets-toi à l'aise et préviens-moi si tu veux commander quelque chose !
russian: [Ari]! Рада тебя видеть. Располагайся, если что — обращайся!
bulgarian: [Ari]! So nice to see you. Make yourself comfortable, and let me know if I can get you anything!

english: Make yourself right at home, [Ari]. We'll bring you a meal when you're ready.
french: Fais comme chez toi, [Ari]. Dis-nous quand tu veux qu'on t'apporte ton repas.
russian:
Чувствуй себя как дома, [Ari]. Принесём еду, когда будешь

готовы

готоваготовготово.
bulgarian: Make yourself right at home, [Ari]. We'll bring you a meal when you're ready.

english: Do you smell that? Reina's cooking something good.
french: Tu sens cette odeur ? Reina prépare quelque chose de délicieux.
russian: Чуешь запах? Рейна снова колдует на кухне!
bulgarian: Do you smell that? Reina's cooking something good.

english: Ooh, Reina's got some fresh ideas for the menu next week, wait till you see them.
french: Ho ho, Reina a de nouvelles idées pour le menu de la semaine prochaine. Tu verras !
russian: Ооо, у Рейны новые идеи для меню на следующую неделю — вот увидишь!
bulgarian: Ooh, Reina's got some fresh ideas for the menu next week, wait till you see them.

english: Reina's setting the menu today! She's so reliable, Hemlock and I are lucky.
french: C'est Reina qui est en cuisine, aujourd'hui ! Hemlock et moi avons beaucoup de chance d'avoir une fille comme elle.
russian: Сегодня меню составляет Рейна! Такая надёжная — мне и Хемлоку с ней повезло.
bulgarian: Reina's setting the menu today! She's so reliable, Hemlock and I are lucky.

english: But my favorite is when she adds some of the story behind how she came up with it, too.
french: Mais ce que je préfère, c'est quand elle raconte aussi en quelques mots comment l'idée lui est venue.
russian: Но больше всего мне нравится, когда она ещё и добавляет историю о том, как этот рецепт придумала.
bulgarian: But my favorite is when she adds some of the story behind how she came up with it, too.

english: She's so creative. In many ways, she reminds me of a younger Hemlock!
french: Elle est tellement créative. Par plein d'aspects, elle me fait penser à Hemlock quand il était plus jeune !
russian: Она такая творческая. Во многом напоминает мне молодого Хемлока!
bulgarian: She's so creative. In many ways, she reminds me of a younger Hemlock!

english: Reina always makes sure to write down a recipe idea whenever one comes to her...
french: Reina note toujours les idées de recettes qui lui viennent à l'esprit...
russian: Рейна всегда записывает идею для рецепта, стоит той прийти ей в голову...
bulgarian: Reina always makes sure to write down a recipe idea whenever one comes to her...

english: Do ti la so fa mi re do!
french: Do, si, la, sol, fa, mi, ré, do !
russian: До-си-ля-соль-фа-ми-ре-до!
bulgarian: Do ti la so fa mi re do!

english: Do re mi fa so la ti do!
french: Do, ré, mi, fa, sol, la, si, do !
russian: До-ре-ми-фа-соль-ля-си-до!
bulgarian: Do re mi fa so la ti do!

english: Just picking up some veggies for today's soup.
french: Je choisis les légumes pour la soupe du jour.
russian: Забежала за овощами для сегодняшнего супа.
bulgarian: Just picking up some veggies for today's soup.

english: I'll want some extra potatoes for next week's soup, and Reina was asking after flour... oh, and honey for my tea...
french: Il me faudra des pommes de terre en plus pour le potage de la semaine prochaine. Reina m'a demandé de la farine... Ah, et du miel pour mon thé...
russian: Мне бы ещё картошки для супа на следующую неделю, Рейна просила муки... ах, да, и мёд для чая...
bulgarian: I'll want some extra potatoes for next week's soup, and Reina was asking after flour... oh, and honey for my tea...

english: Hemlock and I are thinking of doing a little music night at the Inn. Elsie might even join in!
french: Hemlock et moi aimerions organiser une soirée musicale à l'auberge. Elsie pourrait même y participer !
russian: Мы с Хемлоком подумываем устроить музыкальный вечер в трактире. Может, и Элси заглянет!
bulgarian: Hemlock and I are thinking of doing a little music night at the Inn. Elsie might even join in!

english: Sunny days make me want to sing! Sing with me, [Ari]!
french: Quand il fait beau, ça me donne envie de pousser la chansonnette ! Allez, chante avec moi, [Ari] !
russian: Солнечные дни так и тянут петь! Спой со мной, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Sunny days make me want to sing! Sing with me, [Ari]!

english: (Jo is busy performing, you shouldn't interrupt her.)
french: (Jo semble absorbée par sa prestation, mieux vaut ne pas la déranger.)
russian: (Джо выступает — не стоит ей мешать.)
bulgarian: (Jo is busy performing, you shouldn't interrupt her.)

english: And you and I will come and go, / Dancing to and fro...
french: Le temps sera venu de nous retrouver,\n\nPour nous aussi nous mettre à danser...
russian: И ты и я пойдем туда, / Вновь и вновь кружась...
bulgarian: And you and I will come and go, / Dancing to and fro...

english: And when the wind comes by to blow / The silver seeds dance to and fro,
french:
Quand le vent se mettra à souffler,

Faisant danser les champs de blé,
russian: А когда налетят ветра, / Серебряные семена пустятся в пляс,
bulgarian: And when the wind comes by to blow / The silver seeds dance to and fro,

english: Hi, [Ari]! Have you tried the soup today? Get yourself a big helping from the pot!
french: Bonjour [Ari] ! Tu as goûté la soupe du jour ? Sers-t'en donc un grand bol !
russian: Привет, [Ari]! Как тебе суп сегодня? Налей себе побольше из котла!
bulgarian: Hi, [Ari]! Have you tried the soup today? Get yourself a big helping from the pot!

english: Now where did I put that spatula?
french: Mais où ai-je pu mettre cette spatule ?
russian: Так... куда я дела лопатку?
bulgarian: Now where did I put that spatula?

english: Have you seen the special, [Ari]? Reina would love if you tried it.
french: Tu as vu le plat du jour, [Ari] ? Reina serait ravie que tu y goûtes !
russian:
Ты

видели

виделавиделвидело наше блюдо дня, [Ari]? Рейна будет в восторге, если попробуешь.
bulgarian: Have you seen the special, [Ari]? Reina would love if you tried it.

english: On summer mornings, the first thing I do is throw open the windows to get a nice, cool cross-breeze going.
french: En été, la première chose que je fais le matin, c'est d'ouvrir les fenêtres en grand pour créer un courant d'air agréable.
russian: Летними утрами я первым делом распахиваю окна — освежающий сквозняк сразу наполняет дом!
bulgarian: On summer mornings, the first thing I do is throw open the windows to get a nice, cool cross-breeze going.

english: Stick around and get yourself thawed out!
french: Reste donc un moment pour te réchauffer !
russian: Останься и отогрейся как следует!
bulgarian: Stick around and get yourself thawed out!

english: Keeping the Inn all shipshape is a full-time job! Luckily, the whole family pitches in.
french: Tenir une auberge, c'est un travail à temps plein ! Mais heureusement, toute la famille met la main à la pâte.
russian: Держать трактир в порядке — работа на полный день! Хорошо, что вся семья помогает.
bulgarian: Keeping the Inn all shipshape is a full-time job! Luckily, the whole family pitches in.

english: Time to put Luc to bed. He likes to hear bug facts as he drifts off to sleep...
french: Il est l'heure pour Luc d'aller au lit. Il adore écouter des anecdotes sur les insectes pendant qu'il s'endort...
russian: Пора укладывать Люка. Он любит слушать факты о жуках перед сном...
bulgarian: Time to put Luc to bed. He likes to hear bug facts as he drifts off to sleep...

english: Oh my goodness, look at you, you're exhausted. Don't worry, I keep an emergency snack for the kids. You have it.
french: Oh bon sang, tu as l'air d'être sur les rotules. Mais ne t'en fais pas, j'ai toujours un petit quelque chose de prêt pour les enfants, au cas où. Tiens, prends-le.
russian: Боже мой, да ты же еле на ногах стоишь. Не переживай, у меня всегда есть экстренный перекус для детей. Вот, держи.
bulgarian: Oh my goodness, look at you, you're exhausted. Don't worry, I keep an emergency snack for the kids. You have it.

english: Time for my shift in the kitchen. Reina's been working on a new recipe all morning, she needs a break!
french: À mon tour de passer derrière les fourneaux. Reina a passé la matinée sur une nouvelle recette, elle a bien mérité une petite pause !
russian: Пора на смену на кухне. Рейна с утра возится с новым рецептом — пора ей немного передохнуть!
bulgarian: Time for my shift in the kitchen. Reina's been working on a new recipe all morning, she needs a break!

english: Don't forget to try the soup, [Ari]!
french: N'oublie pas de goûter à la soupe du jour, [Ari] !
russian: Не забудь попробовать суп, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Don't forget to try the soup, [Ari]!

english: Watch Reina closely, [Ari]... this kitchen is where the magic happens!
french: Observe bien Reina, [Ari]... C'est dans la cuisine que la magie opère !
russian: Смотри внимательно за Рейной, [Ari]... здесь, на кухне, и происходит волшебство!
bulgarian: Watch Reina closely, [Ari]... this kitchen is where the magic happens!

english: Don't forget to take a big bowl of soup from the Inn's pot, Reina changes the recipe daily!
french: Tu te fais des amis ? Et tu manges à ta faim ?
russian:
Друзей

завели

завелазавёлзавело? А еды хватает?
bulgarian: Don't forget to take a big bowl of soup from the Inn's pot, Reina changes the recipe daily!

english: Don't forget to take a big bowl of soup from the Inn's pot, Reina changes the recipe daily!
bulgarian: Don't forget to take a big bowl of soup from the Inn's pot, Reina changes the recipe daily!

english: Oh [Ari]! Have you had anything to eat yet?
french: Oh, [Ari] ! Ça va ? Tu trouves tes marques en ville ?
russian: Ох, [Ari]! Ты хорошо ориентируешься в городе?
bulgarian: Oh [Ari]! Have you had anything to eat yet?

english: Are you eating enough? Sleeping enough?
french: Tu manges à ta faim ? Tu dors suffisamment ? Ne te couche pas trop tard !
russian: Ты точно ешь как следует? А спишь? Только не засиживайся по ночам!
bulgarian: Are you eating enough? Sleeping enough?

english: You must be working so hard down on the farm, [Ari]!
french: J'imagine que la ferme te demande beaucoup de travail, [Ari] !
russian: Ты, наверное, столько работаешь на ферме, [Ari]!
bulgarian: You must be working so hard down on the farm, [Ari]!

english: Would you mind doing me a little favor?
french: Pourrais-tu me rendre un petit service ?
russian: Можно тебя попросить немного мне помочь?
bulgarian: Would you mind doing me a little favor?

english: I've been a bit worried about Adeline...
french: Je m'inquiète pour Adeline.
russian: Я слегка переживаю за Аделину...
bulgarian: I've been a bit worried about Adeline...

english: She's been working so hard since she took over managing the town in her parents' absence.
french: Elle travaille si dur depuis qu'elle a repris la gestion de la ville en l'absence de ses parents.
russian: С тех пор, как её родители уехали, она взяла городское управление на себя. Трудится не покладая рук.
bulgarian: She's been working so hard since she took over managing the town in her parents' absence.

english: Why don't you bring her a =Coffee=? I feel like she could use a pick-me-up.
french: Peux-tu lui apporter un =café= ? Je pense que ça lui fera le plus grand bien.
russian: Отнесёшь ей =кофе=? Думаю, ей поможет взбодриться.
bulgarian: Why don't you bring her a =Coffee=? I feel like she could use a pick-me-up.

english: And while I'm at it... I feel like you could, too.
french: Et tant qu'on y est... Tu devrais en boire un aussi.
russian: И, кстати... Кажется, тебе тоже не помешает.
bulgarian: And while I'm at it... I feel like you could, too.

english: Oh, [Ari]!
french: Oh, [Ari] !
russian: Ой, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari]!

english: But with the Mill out of commission, what can we do?
french: Mais avec le moulin hors service, que peut-on y faire ?
russian: Но что поделать, раз мельница не работает?
bulgarian: But with the Mill out of commission, what can we do?

english: The price of $Flour$ keeps going up...
french: Le prix de la $farine$ n'arrête pas de grimper...
russian: Цена на $муку$ всё растёт и растёт...
bulgarian: The price of $Flour$ keeps going up...

english: Oh, it's you [Ari]! Hanging in there?
french: Oh, c'est toi [Ari] ! Ça va ? Tu t'en sors ?
russian: О, это ты, [Ari]! Держишься?
bulgarian: Oh, it's you [Ari]! Hanging in there?

english: Welcome to the Sleeping Dragon Inn!
french: Bienvenue à l'auberge du Dragon qui dort !
russian: Добро пожаловать в трактир «Спящий дракон»!
bulgarian: Welcome to the Sleeping Dragon Inn!

english: Welcome to the Sleeping Dragon Inn, [Ari]! Make yourself at home!
french: Bienvenue à l'auberge du Dragon qui dort, [Ari] ! Fais comme chez toi.
russian: Добро пожаловать в трактир «Спящий дракон», [Ari]! Чувствуй себя как дома!
bulgarian: Welcome to the Sleeping Dragon Inn, [Ari]! Make yourself at home!

english: Thank you, [Ari].
french: Merci, [Ari].
russian: Спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari].

english: A birthday gift? Aren't you a sweetheart!
french: Un cadeau d'anniversaire ? Oh, mais tu es un amour !
russian: Подарок на день рождения? Ах, ты душка!
bulgarian: A birthday gift? Aren't you a sweetheart!

english: Oh, =Etouffee=! I love etouffee! I'm going to share this with Hemlock, he loves it too!
french: Oh, un =gumbo= ! J'adore ça ! Je le mangerai avec Hemlock. C'est son péché mignon à lui aussi !
russian: О, =этуфе=! Я обожаю этуфе! Поделюсь с Хемлоком — он тоже его любит!
bulgarian: Oh, =Etouffee=! I love etouffee! I'm going to share this with Hemlock, he loves it too!

english: I see. Well, maybe Luc or Maple can do something with this...
french: Je vois. Peut-être que Luc ou Maple en auront l'utilité...
russian: Вот как. Ну, может, Люк или Мэйпл найдут этому применение...
bulgarian: I see. Well, maybe Luc or Maple can do something with this...

english: Oh, aren't you a good one. Thank you, [Ari].
french: Oh, comme c'est gentil de ta part. Merci, [Ari].
russian: Ах, вот ты молодец. Спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: Oh, aren't you a good one. Thank you, [Ari].

english: Oh, how helpful! Thank you, [Ari].
french: Oh, c'est super ! Merci, [Ari].
russian: Как же это кстати! Спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: Oh, how helpful! Thank you, [Ari].

english: You know, he still surprises me with flowers! It's like he's still courting me, and I don't mind one bit.
french: Tu sais qu'Hemlock m'offre encore des fleurs ? Comme s'il me faisait toujours la cour... et j'aime bien ça.
russian: Знаешь, он до сих пор дарит мне цветы! Будто до сих пор ухаживает. А я и не против.
bulgarian: You know, he still surprises me with flowers! It's like he's still courting me, and I don't mind one bit.

english: Flowers! For me? Why thank you, [Ari].
french: Des fleurs ! Pour moi ? Merci beaucoup, [Ari].
russian: Цветы! Мне? Ну спасибо, [Ari].
bulgarian: Flowers! For me? Why thank you, [Ari].

english: Thank you, [Ari]! This is perfect for the kitchen.
french: Merci, [Ari] ! Ce sera parfait pour la cuisine.
russian: Спасибо, [Ari]! Это идеально для кухни.
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari]! This is perfect for the kitchen.

english: Oh, that smells wonderful! Thank you so much, dear!
french: Oh, comme ça sent bon ! Merci beaucoup, mon chou !
russian: Ох, как вкусно пахнет! Огромное спасибо, дорогуша!
bulgarian: Oh, that smells wonderful! Thank you so much, dear!

english: Aren't you a good egg, [Ari]! You know just what I like!
french: Comme c'est gentil de ta part, [Ari] ! Tu connais bien mes goûts, hein !
russian: Ну ты и молодчина, [Ari]! Точно знаешь, что я люблю!
bulgarian: Aren't you a good egg, [Ari]! You know just what I like!

english: Mm, smell those spices! Incredible! Thank you for sharing, [Ari]. You have a big heart!
french: Mmm, ce que ces épices sentent bon ! Merci de me les avoir données, [Ari]. Tu as vraiment bon cœur !
russian: Ммм, ты только понюхай эти специи! Потрясающе! Спасибо, [Ari]. У тебя доброе сердце!
bulgarian: Mm, smell those spices! Incredible! Thank you for sharing, [Ari]. You have a big heart!

english: Goodness, the fragrance of this tea is divine! Perfect for my next break. Thank you!
french: Oh, ce thé a une odeur divine ! Ce qu'il faut pour ma prochaine pause. Merci !
russian: Боже, как же благоухает этот чай! Идеально для следующего перерыва. Спасибо!
bulgarian: Goodness, the fragrance of this tea is divine! Perfect for my next break. Thank you!

english: Thank you!
french: Merci !
russian: Спасибо!
bulgarian: Thank you!

english: I get bugs two, sometimes three times a day from Luc. I don't need a $Worm$ from you!
french: Luc m'offre déjà des insectes deux à trois fois par jour. Je n'ai pas spécialement besoin d'un $ver de terre$ !
russian: Мне Люк и так приносит насекомых два, а то и три раза в день. Мне твой $червяк$ ни к чему!
bulgarian: I get bugs two, sometimes three times a day from Luc. I don't need a $Worm$ from you!

english: I always visit Darcy's booth when she's here... she has so many =Teas=, there's always a new one to try.
french: Je rends toujours visite à Darcy quand elle est là... Elle a tellement de =thés= différents qu'il y a toujours une nouveauté à goûter.
russian: Я всегда захожу к Дарси, когда она приезжает... у неё столько =чаёв= — всегда можно попробовать что-то новое.
bulgarian: I always visit Darcy's booth when she's here... she has so many =Teas=, there's always a new one to try.

english: I'd say that Hemlock gets about 8 out of 10 gifts for me from Darcy... she has so many =Teas=, he's always able to surprise me.
french: Hemlock trouve la majorité des cadeaux qu'il m'offre chez Darcy... Elle a tellement de =thés= différents qu'il arrive toujours à me surprendre.
russian: Где-то 8 из 10 подарков от Хемлока — из лавки Дарси... у неё столько =чаёв= — он всегда может меня удивить.
bulgarian: I'd say that Hemlock gets about 8 out of 10 gifts for me from Darcy... she has so many =Teas=, he's always able to surprise me.

english: Be sure to try some of Darcy's flower teas... She gets her ingredients right from Celine's garden. A real Mistrian specialty!
french: N'hésite pas à goûter les thés aux fleurs de Darcy... Tous les ingrédients viennent du jardin de Céline. C'est une spécialité mistrienne !
russian: Обязательно попробуй цветочные чаи от Дарси... ингредиенты она берёт прямо из сада Селин. Настоящая мистрийская прелесть!
bulgarian: Be sure to try some of Darcy's flower teas... She gets her ingredients right from Celine's garden. A real Mistrian specialty!

english: I'm supposed to be running errands, but Hemlock bullied me into visiting Darcy when he heard she was in town. He knows I love my =Teas=!
french: Je suis censée faire des courses, mais Hemlock m'a obligée à passer voir Darcy quand il a appris qu'elle était en ville. Il sait que j'adore le =thé= !
russian: Я должна была идти по делам, но Хемлок уговорил заглянуть к Дарси, когда узнал, что она в городе. Он знает, как я люблю =чаи=!
bulgarian: I'm supposed to be running errands, but Hemlock bullied me into visiting Darcy when he heard she was in town. He knows I love my =Teas=!

english: Did you know Louis made my wedding dress? He designed the whole thing around a flower I brought him.
french: Tu savais que c'était Louis qui avait confectionné ma robe de mariage ? Il l'avait conçue en s'inspirant d'une fleur que je lui avais apportée.
russian: Знаешь, Луи сшил мне свадебное платье? Он его придумал, вдохновившись цветком, который я ему принесла.
bulgarian: Did you know Louis made my wedding dress? He designed the whole thing around a flower I brought him.

english: Between you and me, Louis does NOT take well to haggling. Pay the man what he asks, [Ari].
french: Ça reste entre nous, mais Louis n'apprécie pas trop qu'on marchande. Paie le prix qu'il demande, [Ari].
russian: Только между нами, Луи очень НЕ любит торговаться. Плати, сколько просит, [Ari].
bulgarian: Between you and me, Louis does NOT take well to haggling. Pay the man what he asks, [Ari].

english: I saw a cardigan that would look SO adorable on Hemlock, it's even in his colors!
french: J'ai vu un cardigan qui irait à merveille à Hemlock, et dans les tons qu'il aime en plus !
russian: Я увидела кардиган — Хемлоку бы так подошёл! Ещё и его цвета!
bulgarian: I saw a cardigan that would look SO adorable on Hemlock, it's even in his colors!

english: A little bird told me Louis had some new dresses at his booth... I can't wait to try them on!
french: À ce qu'il paraît, Louis a de nouvelles robes en rayon... J'ai hâte de les essayer !
russian: Птичка нашептала, что у Луи новые платья в лавке... не могу дождаться, чтобы их примерить!
bulgarian: A little bird told me Louis had some new dresses at his booth... I can't wait to try them on!

english: Merri is our first stop when we're furnishing the Inn... she's great at restoring furniture.
french: On va toujours chiner chez Merri quand on a besoin de mobilier pour l'auberge... Elle restaure les meubles comme personne.
russian: Мэрри — наш первый пункт, когда обставляем гостиницу... Она замечательно восстанавливает мебель.
bulgarian: Merri is our first stop when we're furnishing the Inn... she's great at restoring furniture.

english: The screen and armchairs in our bedroom are a set we got from Merri several seasons back. She even reupholstered the chairs so nicely!
french: Le paravent et les fauteuils de notre chambre sont un ensemble qu'on a chiné chez Merri il y a déjà pas mal de temps. Elle a même retapissé les assises avec le plus grand soin !
russian: Ширма и кресла в нашей спальне — из комплекта, что мы купили у Мэрри несколько сезонов назад. Она ещё и перетянула их великолепно!
bulgarian: The screen and armchairs in our bedroom are a set we got from Merri several seasons back. She even reupholstered the chairs so nicely!

english: Maple wants the most princessy everything... I've been on the lookout for a canopy bed. Maybe I'll put in a request with Merri...
french: Maple veut une décoration de princesse pour sa chambre... Je cherche un lit à baldaquin. Je vais peut-être demander à Merri qu'elle m'en trouve un...
russian: Мэйпл хочет, чтобы у неё всё было, как у принцессы... Вот я ищу кровать с балдахином. Может, попрошу Мэрри?
bulgarian: Maple wants the most princessy everything... I've been on the lookout for a canopy bed. Maybe I'll put in a request with Merri...

english: My goodness, how does Merri get her booth set up? Everything looks so heavy!
french: Je me demande comment Merri arrive à installer son stand. Tout a l'air vraiment lourd à porter !
russian: Боже, как Мэрри удаётся расставить всё в своей лавке? Всё выглядит таким тяжелым!
bulgarian: My goodness, how does Merri get her booth set up? Everything looks so heavy!

english: Once upon a time, Stillwell predicted a mysterious stranger with a big appetite would come to Mistria...and the next day you rolled into town!
bulgarian: Once upon a time, Stillwell predicted a mysterious stranger with a big appetite would come to Mistria...and the next day you rolled into town!

english: I always bring Stillwell lunch when he's working the Saturday Market... something about that one makes you want to take care of him. It might be all the wailing.
bulgarian: I always bring Stillwell lunch when he's working the Saturday Market... something about that one makes you want to take care of him. It might be all the wailing.

english: Stillwell said "Welcome the visitor in blue, or face calamity upon calamity"... Luc's new beetle is blue... coincidence?
bulgarian: Stillwell said "Welcome the visitor in blue, or face calamity upon calamity"... Luc's new beetle is blue... coincidence?

english: Nora always asks for a money fortune... well, she is very pragmatic...
bulgarian: Nora always asks for a money fortune... well, she is very pragmatic...

english: I'm not so interested in Taliferro's $Cooking Challenge$, but his kitchen? It's a beauty!
french: Le $défi gastronomique$ de Taliferro ne m'intéresse pas vraiment. En revanche, il a un équipement à tomber.
russian: Меня не очень интересует $смотр блюд$ Талиферро. А вот его кухня — просто чудо!
bulgarian: I'm not so interested in Taliferro's $Cooking Challenge$, but his kitchen? It's a beauty!

english: You've practiced so much to build up your skills! Reina's always saying so!
french: Tu as beaucoup appris en cuisine ! C'est Reina qui le dit !
russian:
Ты так долго

оттачивали

оттачивалаоттачивалоттачивало навык! Рейна часто про это говорит!
bulgarian: You've practiced so much to build up your skills! Reina's always saying so!

english: Are you thinking of entering Taliferro's $Cooking Challenge$? You ought to!
french: Tu comptes participer au $défi gastronomique$ de Taliferro ? Tu devrais !
russian: Хочешь поучаствовать в $смотре блюд$ Талиферро? Тебе стоило бы!
bulgarian: Are you thinking of entering Taliferro's $Cooking Challenge$? You ought to!

english: The Sleeping Dragon Inn doesn't need a traveling kitchen, but if we did, I bet Taliferro's would do the trick!
french: L'auberge du Dragon qui dort n'a pas besoin d'une cuisine roulante, mais si c'était le cas, celle de Taliferro serait idéale !
russian: Нам в трактире «Спящий дракон» переносная кухня не нужна. Но если выбирать, то у Талиферро — то что надо!
bulgarian: The Sleeping Dragon Inn doesn't need a traveling kitchen, but if we did, I bet Taliferro's would do the trick!

english: And I say a LOT...
french: Et j'en dis BEAUCOUP...
russian: А о нём МНОГО можно наговорить...
bulgarian: And I say a LOT...

english: But he does run a clean kitchen. Gotta respect that.
french: Mais sa cuisine est toujours impeccable. Il faut lui reconnaître ça.
russian: Но в кухне у него идеальный порядок. Это я уважаю.
bulgarian: But he does run a clean kitchen. Gotta respect that.

english: Say what you will about Taliferro...
french: On peut dire ce qu'on veut sur Taliferro...
russian: Что ни говори о Талиферро...
bulgarian: Say what you will about Taliferro...

english: Maple keeps saying she wants to try out pink hair. Where do you suppose she got that idea?
french: Maple n'arrête pas de dire qu'elle veut se teindre les cheveux en rose. Je ne sais pas d'où elle tient cette idée.
russian: Мэйпл всё твердит, что хочет розовые волосы. Как думаешь, откуда у неё такие идеи?
bulgarian: Maple keeps saying she wants to try out pink hair. Where do you suppose she got that idea?

english: It does take a while, but really it's an excuse to catch up!
french: C'est vrai que ça prend du temps, mais c'est aussi l'occasion pour nous de papoter !
russian: Это занимает много времени, потому что на самом деле это просто повод поболтать!
bulgarian: It does take a while, but really it's an excuse to catch up!

english: Vera usually asks me to schedule in advance with her when I want to get my hair done.
french: En règle générale, Vera me demande de prendre rendez-vous quand j'ai envie de faire quelque chose pour mes cheveux.
russian: Вера обычно просит меня записываться заранее, если я хочу привести волосы в порядок.
bulgarian: Vera usually asks me to schedule in advance with her when I want to get my hair done.

english: When I told Hemlock I might have Vera dye my hair purple, he got so excited... that sweet man does love when I express my artistic side.
french: Hemlock piaffait littéralement quand je lui ai dit que Vera allait peut-être me teindre les cheveux en violet... Il aime mon côté artistique.
russian: Когда я сказала Хемлоку, что, может, покрашусь у Веры в фиолетовый, он так обрадовался... этот милый человек обожает, когда я проявляю свою творческую натуру.
bulgarian: When I told Hemlock I might have Vera dye my hair purple, he got so excited... that sweet man does love when I express my artistic side.

english: Reina says she's thinking of dyeing her hair... It might be a fun mother-daughter activity.
french: Reina aimerait se faire teindre les cheveux... Ce serait l'occasion de passer un bon moment entre mère et fille.
russian: Рейна говорит, что подумывает о покраске... Может, устроим с ней совместную авантюру.
bulgarian: Reina says she's thinking of dyeing her hair... It might be a fun mother-daughter activity.

english: That smile is too sneaky, [Ari]! I just don't trust it!
french: Regarde ce sourire faux, [Ari] ! Je ne lui fais pas confiance.
russian: Слишком хитрая у него улыбочка, [Ari]! Она никак не вызывает доверия!
bulgarian: That smile is too sneaky, [Ari]! I just don't trust it!

english: Sweet Hemlock told me not to trust a word out of Wheedle's mouth, but I don't even need to hear that man talk.
french: Hemlock m'a dit de ne pas croire un mot de ce que dit Wheedle, mais je n'ai pas attendu pour me méfier.
russian: Мой милый Хемлок сказал не верить ни слову от Хлюста. Но я и без слов ему не верю.
bulgarian: Sweet Hemlock told me not to trust a word out of Wheedle's mouth, but I don't even need to hear that man talk.

english: But when you put those looks on a guy like Wheedle, it tells a whole different story, doesn't it?
french: Mais sur un type comme Wheedle, ça ne fait pas du tout le même effet.
russian: Но если такой костюм надеть на кого-то вроде Хлюста, образ выходит совсем другой, правда?
bulgarian: But when you put those looks on a guy like Wheedle, it tells a whole different story, doesn't it?

english: When Hemlock and I were in the band, we had some flashy looks...
french: Quand Hemlock et moi étions dans notre groupe, on avait des tenues flashy...
russian: Когда у нас с Хемлоком была группа, костюмы у нас были довольно вычурные...
bulgarian: When Hemlock and I were in the band, we had some flashy looks...

english: But I saw him pull that grass up on his way into town! And I can do that myself, thank you very much.
french: Le truc, c'est que je l'ai vu couper de l'herbe en venant ici ! Je peux en faire autant, merci beaucoup.
russian: Но я видела, как он рвёт траву на подъезде к городу! А это я и сама могу сделать, спасибо большое.
bulgarian: But I saw him pull that grass up on his way into town! And I can do that myself, thank you very much.

english: Wheedle figured out that I like tea, so now he's always trying to sell me some new kind of blend from some faraway place.
french: Wheedle a découvert que j'aimais le thé. Maintenant, il veut absolument de me vendre un mélange qui viendrait de l'autre bout du monde.
russian: Хлюст прознал, что я люблю чай, и теперь всё время пытается продать мне какие-то новые купажи из далёких стран.
bulgarian: Wheedle figured out that I like tea, so now he's always trying to sell me some new kind of blend from some faraway place.

english: You wouldn't believe the tab that man has racked up at the Sleeping Dragon Inn.
french: Tu n'imagines même pas son ardoise à l'auberge du Dragon qui dort.
russian: Ты даже не представляешь, какой у него скопился счёт в трактире «Спящий дракон».
bulgarian: You wouldn't believe the tab that man has racked up at the Sleeping Dragon Inn.

english: Take it from me, [Ari]... never accept an IOU from Wheedle.
french: Écoute-moi, [Ari]... N'accepte jamais une reconnaissance de dettes de la part de Wheedle.
russian: Послушай мой совет, [Ari]... никогда не принимай от Хлюста оплату в долг.
bulgarian: Take it from me, [Ari]... never accept an IOU from Wheedle.

english: We're friends with her folks you know, back when Hemlock used to be in that band of his.
french: On est amis avec ses parents, tu sais. Ça date de l'époque où Hemlock avait son groupe.
russian: Знаешь, мы же дружим с ей родителями. Ещё с той поры, когда Хемлок играл в группе.
bulgarian: We're friends with her folks you know, back when Hemlock used to be in that band of his.

english: I've known her since she was Luc's age!
french: Je la connais depuis qu'elle a l'âge de Luc !
russian: Я её помню маленькой, как сейчас наш Люк!
bulgarian: I've known her since she was Luc's age!

english: Goodness, it is so nice to have Zorel in town!
french: Alors, ça, c'est vraiment chouette d'avoir Zorel en ville !
russian: Как же приятно, что Зорель к нам приехала!
bulgarian: Goodness, it is so nice to have Zorel in town!

english: I thought I might commission March to make one =for Hemlock=.
french: Je me suis dit que je pourrais peut-être demander à March d'en fabriquer une =pour Hemlock=.
russian: Вот думаю, не заказать ли Марту такой же =для Хемлока=.
bulgarian: I thought I might commission March to make one =for Hemlock=.

english: I was looking at that =Caldosian Drinking Horn= they've got on exhibit at the Museum, [Ari]. It's so dashing!
french: Je regardais la =corne à boire caldosienne= qu'ils ont exposée au musée, [Ari]. Elle est vraiment splendide !
russian: Засмотрелась на =кальдосийский рог для питья=, что выставлен в музее, [Ari]. Такой стильный!
bulgarian: I was looking at that =Caldosian Drinking Horn= they've got on exhibit at the Museum, [Ari]. It's so dashing!

english: He heard that $Crystalline Cricket$ at the Museum sings to stones, and now he wants to do it too!
french: Il a entendu le $criquet cristallin$ du musée chanter pour les pierres et maintenant, il veut faire pareil !
russian: Услышал, что $кристальный сверчок$ в музее поёт камням — и теперь тоже так хочет!
bulgarian: He heard that $Crystalline Cricket$ at the Museum sings to stones, and now he wants to do it too!

english: Olric came in here the other day, asking me to teach him how to sing.
french: Olric est passé l'autre jour pour me demander de lui apprendre à chanter.
russian: Ольрик недавно заходил и попросил меня научить его петь.
bulgarian: Olric came in here the other day, asking me to teach him how to sing.

english: I'd like to be the judge of that!
french: Je voudrais bien goûter pour voir !
russian: Я была бы не против оценить лично!
bulgarian: I'd like to be the judge of that!

english: The $Flame Pepper$ at the Museum... apparently, it's quite spicy.
french: Il paraît que le $piment de lave$ du musée... est très piquant.
russian: У нас в музее лежит $огненный перец$... Говорят, он весьма острый.
bulgarian: The $Flame Pepper$ at the Museum... apparently, it's quite spicy.

english: I wonder if it makes a nice tea?
french: Je me demande ce qu'il donnerait en infusion...
russian: Интересно, хороший из него получится чай?
bulgarian: I wonder if it makes a nice tea?

english: The luminescent $Spirit Mushroom$ at the Museum... I'd never seen one before. What a color!
french: Ce $cérébolet$ fluorescent au musée... Je n'en avais jamais vu avant. Il a des couleurs magnifiques !
russian: $Призрачный гриб$ в музее так светится... Я такого никогда ещё не видела. И какой цвет!
bulgarian: The luminescent $Spirit Mushroom$ at the Museum... I'd never seen one before. What a color!
